questions.text: Which input sources should v0.1 scan for links?
options: Markdown files in a given directory (recursive)

questions.text: What exactly counts as 'rotted' for a link?
options: Non-2xx (treat 3xx chain ending non-2xx as rot)
2xx required AND final URL matches original host

questions.text: How should we handle concurrency, retries, and per-host politeness?
options: Fixed global concurrency (e.g. 10), no per-host limit
Global + per-host concurrency cap with retry/backoff
Per-host serial, global parallel, 1 retry on 5xx/timeout

questions.text: What output format(s) should the CLI produce for v0.1?
options: Human-readable text + non-zero exit on rot

questions.text: Which adjacent features are explicitly OUT of scope for v0.1?
options: No crawling beyond the listed files (no link-following)

answers.choice: Markdown files in a given directory (recursive)
Fixed global concurrency (e.g. 10), no per-host limit
Human-readable text + non-zero exit on rot
